3.45.s:
3.221
.. vajra uvāca ..
kiṃ nu kṛtyatamaṃ loke manuṣyāṇāṃ prakīrtitam ..
etatpṛṣṭo mamācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara .. 1..
3.45.d:
3.221
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
किं नु कृत्यतमं लोके मनुष्याणां प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
एतत्पृष्टो ममाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतां वर ॥ 1॥
3.45.m:
3.221
Vajra said:
What indeed is declared in the world as the foremost duty of human beings? / Being asked this, tell me, O best among upholders of all dharma.

3.45.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
antarvedi bahirvedi pūjā kāryā divaukasām ..
etatkṛtyatamaṃ loke puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ .. .. 2 ..
3.45.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अन्तर्वेदि बहिर्वेदि पूजा कार्या दिवौकसाम् ॥
एतत्कृत्यतमं लोके पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः ॥ ॥ 2 ॥
3.45.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Worship of the gods is to be performed inside the altar-ground and outside the altar-ground; / this is the foremost duty in the world of a wise person.

3.45.s:
antarvedyāṃ ca yajanaṃ bahuvittasya kīrtitam..
svalpavittasya dharmajña bahirvedi prakīrtitam .. 3..
3.45.d:
अन्तर्वेद्यां च यजनं बहुवित्तस्य कीर्तितम्॥
स्वल्पवित्तस्य धर्मज्ञ बहिर्वेदि प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 3॥
3.45.m: Sacrifice within the altar-ground is proclaimed for one of abundant wealth; / for one of little wealth, O knower of dharma, [worship] outside the altar-ground is proclaimed.

3.45.s:
puṣpānnagandhanaivedyastotrādhyayanakarmaṇā ..
dhūpadīpanamaskārairnityaṃ pūjyā divaukasaḥ ..4..
3.45.d:
पुष्पान्नगन्धनैवेद्यस्तोत्राध्ययनकर्मणा ॥
धूपदीपनमस्कारैर्नित्यं पूज्या दिवौकसः ॥4॥
3.45.m: The gods should always be worshipped with flowers, food, fragrant scents, and food-offerings, / with hymns and acts of recitation, and with incense, lamps, and obeisances.

3.45.s:
tato'pi niyamaiścaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ..
bahiḥ śuśrūṣayā caiva dānena vividhena ca.. 5 ..
3.45.d:
ततोऽपि नियमैश्चैव ब्राह्मणानां च तर्पणैः ॥
बहिः शुश्रूषया चैव दानेन विविधेन च॥ 5 ॥
3.45.m: Further, by observances, by satisfying the brahmins, / by service outside, and by various forms of giving,

3.45.s:
sadaiva pūjitā devāstuṣṭimāyānti yādava ..
svesve kālaviśeṣeṇa kālaḥ pūrvodito mayā .. 6 ..
3.45.d:
सदैव पूजिता देवास्तुष्टिमायान्ति यादव ॥
स्वेस्वे कालविशेषेण कालः पूर्वोदितो मया ॥ 6 ॥
3.45.m: gods worshipped at all times attain satisfaction, O Yādava, / according to their respective particular times; the time has been declared by me previously.

3.45.s:
vajra uvāca ..
devatāḥ kāśca kasminnu kāle saṃpūjayetsadā ..
devatāpūjane kāryaṃ viśeṣānmama kīrtaya .. 7 ..
3.45.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
देवताः काश्च कस्मिन्नु काले संपूजयेत्सदा ॥
देवतापूजने कार्यं विशेषान्मम कीर्तय ॥ 7 ॥
3.45.m:
Vajra said:
Which deities should one always worship, and at what time? / Tell me specifically the duty in worshipping the deities.

3.45.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kālaṃ tathāhaṃ vakṣyāmi devatāpūjane pṛthak ..
saṃvatsareṇa dharmajña sopavāsasya sarvadā .. 8 ..
3.45.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कालं तथाहं वक्ष्यामि देवतापूजने पृथक् ॥
संवत्सरेण धर्मज्ञ सोपवासस्य सर्वदा ॥ 8 ॥
3.45.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I shall speak likewise of the specific time in worshipping the deities / over the course of a year, O knower of dharma, for one who constantly fasts.

3.45.s:
brahmāṇaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ satataṃ prathamehani ..
pakṣadvaye mahābhāga pañcadaśyāmupoṣitaḥ .. 9 ..
3.45.d:
ब्रह्माणं पूजयेद्देवं सततं प्रथमेहनि ॥
पक्षद्वये महाभाग पञ्चदश्यामुपोषितः ॥ 9 ॥
3.45.m: One should worship the god Brahmā continually on the first day; / fasting on the fifteenth day in both fortnights, O fortunate one,

3.45.s:
saṃvatsareṇa dharmajña vidyādbahusuvarṇakam..
haṃsayuktena yānena brahmaloke ca gacchati..3.221.10..
3.45.d:
संवत्सरेण धर्मज्ञ विद्याद्बहुसुवर्णकम्॥
हंसयुक्तेन यानेन ब्रह्मलोके च गच्छति॥3.221.10॥
3.45.m: in the course of a year, O knower of dharma, one acquires much gold; / and he goes to the world of Brahmā in a vehicle harnessed with swans.

3.45.s:
caitramāsasya yā śukle prathamā pratipadbhavet.
tadahni brahmaṇaḥ kṛtvā sopavāsastu pūjanam..11..
3.45.d:
चैत्रमासस्य या शुक्ले प्रथमा प्रतिपद्भवेत्।
तदह्नि ब्रह्मणः कृत्वा सोपवासस्तु पूजनम्॥11॥
3.45.m: That which is the first lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra: / having performed the worship of Brahmā on that day while fasting,

3.45.s:
saṃvatsaramavāpnoti saukhyāni bhṛgunandana ..
kālasyāvayavāḥ sarve tasminnahani pūjitāḥ..12.
3.45.d:
संवत्सरमवाप्नोति सौख्यानि भृगुनन्दन ॥
कालस्यावयवाः सर्वे तस्मिन्नहनि पूजिताः॥12.
3.45.m: one obtains pleasures for a whole year, O son of Bhṛgu; / all the divisions of time are worshipped on that day.

3.45.s:
graharkṣāṇi ca dharmajña saukhyaṃ dadyādanuttamam..
saṃvatsarādhipaṃ nāgaṃ tasminnahani pūjayet..13..
3.45.d:
ग्रहर्क्षाणि च धर्मज्ञ सौख्यं दद्यादनुत्तमम्॥
संवत्सराधिपं नागं तस्मिन्नहनि पूजयेत्॥13॥
3.45.m: The planets and lunar mansions, O knower of dharma, grant unequalled happiness; / one should worship the serpent who is the lord of the year on that day.

3.45.s:
grahebhyaḥ saukhyamāpnoti svāsthyamagryaṃ tathaiva ca..
tatrāhni brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ prathamaṃ dvija..14..
3.45.d:
ग्रहेभ्यः सौख्यमाप्नोति स्वास्थ्यमग्र्यं तथैव च॥
तत्राह्नि ब्रह्मणा सृष्टं त्रैलोक्यं प्रथमं द्विज॥14॥
3.45.m: He obtains happiness from the planets and likewise foremost health; / on that day, the three worlds were first created by Brahmā, O twice-born.

3.45.s:
dakṣaṃ prajāpatiṃ nityaṃ dvitīyāyāmathārcayet ..
phalamāpnoti dharmajña gosavasya na saṃśayaḥ ..15..
3.45.d:
दक्षं प्रजापतिं नित्यं द्वितीयायामथार्चयेत् ॥
फलमाप्नोति धर्मज्ञ गोसवस्य न संशयः ॥15॥
3.45.m: Then one should always worship Dakṣa Prajāpati on the second [lunar day]; / he obtains the fruit of a Gosava sacrifice, O knower of dharma, without doubt.

3.45.s:
tathā nāsatyayoḥ kṛtvā tasminnahani pūjanam ..
nityamārogyamāpnoti tathā rūpaṃ ca bhārgava..16..
3.45.d:
तथा नासत्ययोः कृत्वा तस्मिन्नहनि पूजनम् ॥
नित्यमारोग्यमाप्नोति तथा रूपं च भार्गव॥16॥
3.45.m: Likewise, having performed the worship of the two Nāsatyas on that day, / he constantly obtains health and also beauty, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

3.45.s:
śuklapakṣadvitīyāyāṃ bālacandrasya pūjanam..
kṛtvā dattvā ca lavaṇaṃ prāgrātrau subhago bhavet..17..
3.45.d:
शुक्लपक्षद्वितीयायां बालचन्द्रस्य पूजनम्॥
कृत्वा दत्त्वा च लवणं प्राग्रात्रौ सुभगो भवेत्॥17॥
3.45.m: Having performed the worship of the crescent moon on the second day of the bright fortnight / and having given salt early at night, he becomes fortunate.

3.45.s:
sādhyā dvādaśa ye proktāsteṣāṃ kṛtvā tu pūjanam..
tṛtīyasyāṃ mahābhāga dvādaśāhaphalaṃ labhet..18..
3.45.d:
साध्या द्वादश ये प्रोक्तास्तेषां कृत्वा तु पूजनम्॥
तृतीयस्यां महाभाग द्वादशाहफलं लभेत्॥18॥
3.45.m: Having performed the worship of the Sādhyas who are proclaimed as twelve, / on the third [lunar day], O fortunate one, he obtains the fruit of a twelve-day sacrifice.

3.45.s:
tṛtīyāyāṃ tathābhyarcya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān..
pṛthakpṛthaṅmahābhāga trivargaphalabhāgbhaveta .. .. 19..
3.45.d:
तृतीयायां तथाभ्यर्च्य ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान्॥
पृथक्पृथङ्महाभाग त्रिवर्गफलभाग्भवेत ॥ ॥ 19॥
3.45.m: Likewise, having worshipped Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara on the third [lunar day] / separately, O fortunate one, he partakes of the fruit of the threefold aims of life.

3.45.s:
trīṃllokāṃśca tadā rāma samyaksaṃpūjayennaraḥ ..
aiśvaryaṃ mahadāpnoti gatimagryāṃ ca vindati ..3.221.20..
3.45.d:
त्रींल्लोकांश्च तदा राम सम्यक्संपूजयेन्नरः ॥
ऐश्वर्यं महदाप्नोति गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥3.221.20॥
3.45.m: Then, O Rāma, if a person properly worships the three worlds, / he obtains great sovereignty and attains the foremost destination.

3.45.s:
tṛtīyā śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇā yā syācchravaṇasaṃyutā ..
tasyāṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ puṣṭimagryāmavāpnuyāt ..21..
3.45.d:
तृतीया श्रावणे कृष्णा या स्याच्छ्रवणसंयुता ॥
तस्यां संपूज्य गोविन्दं पुष्टिमग्र्यामवाप्नुयात् ॥21॥
3.45.m: The third [lunar day] in the dark [fortnight] of Śrāvaṇa that is conjoined with Śravaṇā— / having worshipped Govinda on that day, one obtains the foremost prosperity.

3.45.s:
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitaḥ..
akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti sarvasya sukṛtasya tu .. 22..
3.45.d:
वैशाखशुक्लपक्षे तु तृतीयायामुपोषितः॥
अक्षयं फलमाप्नोति सर्वस्य सुकृतस्य तु ॥ 22॥
3.45.m: Fasting on the third [lunar day] in the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, / one obtains imperishable fruit for all of one's good deeds.

3.45.s:
sā tathā kṛttikopetā viśeṣeṇa ca pūjitā ..
tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ sarvaṃ saphalamucyate .. 23 ..
3.45.d:
सा तथा कृत्तिकोपेता विशेषेण च पूजिता ॥
तत्र दत्तं हुतं तप्तं सर्वं सफलमुच्यते ॥ 23 ॥
3.45.m: When it is also joined with Kṛttikā and specially worshipped, / whatever is given, offered into the fire, or performed as austerity there is said to be completely fruitful.

3.45.s:
akṣayā sā tithiryasmāttasmātsukṛtamakṣayam ..
akṣataiḥ pūjyate viṣṇustena sāpyakṣatā smṛtā ..24..
3.45.d:
अक्षया सा तिथिर्यस्मात्तस्मात्सुकृतमक्षयम् ॥
अक्षतैः पूज्यते विष्णुस्तेन साप्यक्षता स्मृता ॥24॥
3.45.m: Because that lunar day is imperishable (akṣayā), the merit is therefore imperishable. / Viṣṇu is worshipped with unbroken grains (akṣata), and therefore it is also known as Akṣatā.

3.45.s:
akṣataistu naraḥ snāto viṣṇordattvā tathākṣatān ..
saktūnsusaṃskṛtām̐ścaiva hutvā caiva tathākṣatān .. 25..
3.45.d:
अक्षतैस्तु नरः स्नातो विष्णोर्दत्त्वा तथाक्षतान् ॥
सक्तून्सुसंस्कृताम्̐श्चैव हुत्वा चैव तथाक्षतान् ॥ 25॥
3.45.m: A man bathed with unbroken grains, having offered unbroken grains to Viṣṇu, / and well-prepared barley meal, and having also offered unbroken grains into the fire,

3.45.s:
vipreṣu dattvā tāneva tathā saktuṃ susaṃskṛtam ..
yavānnabhuṅ mahārāja phalamakṣayyamaśnute ..26 ..
3.45.d:
विप्रेषु दत्त्वा तानेव तथा सक्तुं सुसंस्कृतम् ॥
यवान्नभुङ् महाराज फलमक्षय्यमश्नुते ॥26 ॥
3.45.m: and having given those very things to brahmins, as well as well-prepared barley meal, / eating barley food, O great king, enjoys imperishable fruit.

3.45.s:
ekāmapyuktavatkṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ bhṛgunandana ..
eṣāmabdatṛtīyānāṃ sarvāsāṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet ..27..
3.45.d:
एकामप्युक्तवत्कृत्वा तृतीयां भृगुनन्दन ॥
एषामब्दतृतीयानां सर्वासां तत्फलं भवेत् ॥27॥
3.45.m: Having observed even a single third [lunar day] as described, O descendant of Bhṛgu, / that [very] fruit of all these third [lunar days] of the year is obtained.

3.45.s:
proktāstu bhṛgavo nāma devā dvādaśa ye purā ..
caturthyāṃ pūjanaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā divamavāpnuyāt .. 28 ..
3.45.d:
प्रोक्तास्तु भृगवो नाम देवा द्वादश ये पुरा ॥
चतुर्थ्यां पूजनं तेषां कृत्वा दिवमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 28 ॥
3.45.m: Those twelve gods who were declared of old to be named Bhṛgus— / having worshipped them on the fourth [lunar day], one attains heaven.

3.45.s:
yamasya pūjanaṃ kṛtvā caturthyāmeva dhārmikaḥ ..
nāpnoti nārakaṃ duḥkhaṃ tuṣṭe ravisute naraḥ .. 29 ..
3.45.d:
यमस्य पूजनं कृत्वा चतुर्थ्यामेव धार्मिकः ॥
नाप्नोति नारकं दुःखं तुष्टे रविसुते नरः ॥ 29 ॥
3.45.m: Having performed the worship of Yama on the fourth [lunar day], a righteous / man does not incur infernal suffering when the son of Ravi is pleased.

3.45.s:
vināyakamathābhyarcya caturthyāṃ yadunandana ..
sarvavighnavinirmuktaḥ kāryasiddhimavāpnuyāt .. 3.221.30 ..
3.45.d:
विनायकमथाभ्यर्च्य चतुर्थ्यां यदुनन्दन ॥
सर्वविघ्नविनिर्मुक्तः कार्यसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.221.30 ॥
3.45.m: Then, having worshipped Vināyaka on the fourth [lunar day], O delight of the Yadus, / freed from all obstacles, one attains success in one's undertakings.

3.45.s:
nidrāṃ ratiṃ tathā śraddhāṃ kīrtiṃ medhāṃ sarasvatīm ..
prajñāṃ tuṣṭiṃ tathā kāntiṃ tasminnahani pūjayet .. 31 ..
3.45.d:
निद्रां रतिं तथा श्रद्धां कीर्तिं मेधां सरस्वतीम् ॥
प्रज्ञां तुष्टिं तथा कान्तिं तस्मिन्नहनि पूजयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
3.45.m: Nidrā, Rati, and likewise Śraddhā, Kīrti, Medhā, Sarasvatī, / Prajñā, Tuṣṭi, and likewise Kānti one should worship on that day.

3.45.s:
tatprasādamavāpnoti yatheṣṭaṃ manujottama ..
vidyākāmo viśeṣeṇa pūjayettu sarasvatīm .. 32 ..
3.45.d:
तत्प्रसादमवाप्नोति यथेष्टं मनुजोत्तम ॥
विद्याकामो विशेषेण पूजयेत्तु सरस्वतीम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.45.m: One attains their grace according to one's desire, O best of men. / One desiring learning, in particular, should worship Sarasvatī.

3.45.s:
devānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvāstathā tatrāhni pūjitāḥ ..
sarvakāmapradā jñeyāḥ puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ .. 33 ..
3.45.d:
देवानां मातरः सर्वास्तथा तत्राह्नि पूजिताः ॥
सर्वकामप्रदा ज्ञेयाः पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः ॥ 33 ॥
3.45.m: All the Mothers of the gods worshipped on that day / should be known as granting all desires to a wise man.

3.45.s:
pañcamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tathā candramaso naraḥ ..
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti yaśaścāgryaṃ ca vindati .. 34 ..
3.45.d:
पञ्चम्यां पूजनं कृत्वा तथा चन्द्रमसो नरः ॥
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति यशश्चाग्र्यं च विन्दति ॥ 34 ॥
3.45.m: Having performed worship of the Moon on the fifth [lunar day], a man / attains great good fortune and gains foremost fame.

3.45.s:
pañcamyāṃ pṛthivīṃ devīṃ tathā sampūjayennaraḥ ..
tāmevāpnotyayatnena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 35 ..
3.45.d:
पञ्चम्यां पृथिवीं देवीं तथा सम्पूजयेन्नरः ॥
तामेवाप्नोत्ययत्नेन नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 35 ॥
3.45.m: A man should likewise worship the goddess Earth on the fifth [lunar day]; / he gains her without effort—no doubt should be entertained on this point.

3.45.s:
viśvedevāstu ye proktāḥ pūrvameva mayā daśa ..
teṣāṃ sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā pañcamyāṃ divamāpnuyāt .. 36 ..
3.45.d:
विश्वेदेवास्तु ये प्रोक्ताः पूर्वमेव मया दश ॥
तेषां सम्पूजनं कृत्वा पञ्चम्यां दिवमाप्नुयात् ॥ 36 ॥
3.45.m: The Viśvedevas who were previously declared by me to be ten— / having worshipped them on the fifth [lunar day], one attains heaven.

3.45.s:
iṣṭagandharvamabhyarcya pañcamyāṃ subhago bhavet ..
tathā citrarathaṃ teṣāṃ rājānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 37 ..
3.45.d:
इष्टगन्धर्वमभ्यर्च्य पञ्चम्यां सुभगो भवेत् ॥
तथा चित्ररथं तेषां राजानं च विशेषतः ॥ 37 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped one's chosen Gandharva on the fifth [lunar day], one becomes fortunate, / and especially their king Citraratha.

3.45.s:
devabhāryāṃ tathā bhāryāṃ sampūjya subhago bhavet ..
iṣṭamapsarasaṃ caiva tathā rūpamavāpnuyāt .. 38 ..
3.45.d:
देवभार्यां तथा भार्यां सम्पूज्य सुभगो भवेत् ॥
इष्टमप्सरसं चैव तथा रूपमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 38 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped a divine consort and one's wife, one becomes fortunate; / and [worshipping] one's chosen Apsaras, one likewise gains beauty.

3.45.s:
iṣṭaṃ nāgaṃ tathābhyarcya śriyamāpnotyanuttamām ..
vāruṇaiḥ puṣkarasyārcāṃ pañcamyāṃ yaḥ samācaret .. 39 ..
3.45.d:
इष्टं नागं तथाभ्यर्च्य श्रियमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
वारुणैः पुष्करस्यार्चां पञ्चम्यां यः समाचरेत् ॥ 39 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped one's chosen Nāga, one attains unexcelled fortune. / Whoever performs the worship of Puṣkara with [mantras] sacred to Varuṇa on the fifth [lunar day]

3.45.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya somayajñaphalaṃ bhavet ..
tathā ca pūjayanrājaṃstathā vai nalakūbaram .. 3.221.40 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य सोमयज्ञफलं भवेत् ॥
तथा च पूजयन्राजंस्तथा वै नलकूबरम् ॥ 3.221.40 ॥
3.45.m: obtains the fruit of a Soma sacrifice, enriched with all desires; / and likewise, O king, worshipping Nalakūbara.

3.45.s:
śriyaḥ sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā pañcamyāṃ prayataḥ sadā ..
śriyamāpnoti vipulāṃ matimagryāṃ ca vindati .. 41..
3.45.d:
श्रियः सम्पूजनं कृत्वा पञ्चम्यां प्रयतः सदा ॥
श्रियमाप्नोति विपुलां मतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥ 41॥
3.45.m: Having performed the worship of Śrī on the fifth [lunar day], always restrained, / one attains abundant fortune and gains the foremost intellect.

3.45.s: caitraśuklasya pañcamyāṃ pūjayitvā tathā śriyam..42..
3.45.d: चैत्रशुक्लस्य पञ्चम्यां पूजयित्वा तथा श्रियम्॥42॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped Śrī on the fifth [lunar day] of the bright [fortnight] of Caitra,

3.45.s:
sakṛdevāpnuyādrājanphalaṃ saṃvatsaroditam ..
sarvasyāṃ nṛpa pañcamyāṃ ratiṃ prītiṃ sarasvatīm..43..
3.45.d:
सकृदेवाप्नुयाद्राजन्फलं संवत्सरोदितम् ॥
सर्वस्यां नृप पञ्चम्यां रतिं प्रीतिं सरस्वतीम्॥43॥
3.45.m: even once, O king, one obtains the fruit proclaimed for a whole year. / On every fifth [lunar day], O king, [worshipping] Rati, Prīti, Sarasvatī,

3.45.s:
umāṃ menāṃ bhadrakālīṃ tathā kātyāyanīmapi ..
dhṛtiṃ svāhāṃ sudhāmṛddhimanusūyāṃ tathā kṣamām..44..
3.45.d:
उमां मेनां भद्रकालीं तथा कात्यायनीमपि ॥
धृतिं स्वाहां सुधामृद्धिमनुसूयां तथा क्षमाम्॥44॥
3.45.m: Umā, Menā, Bhadrakālī, and likewise Kātyāyanī, / Dhṛti, Svāhā, Sudhā, Ṛddhi, Anusūyā, and likewise Kṣamā,

3.45.s:
subhīmāṃ devasenāṃ ca velāṃ jyotsnāṃ tathā śacīm..
gaurīṃ varuṇapatnīṃ ca yamapatnīṃ tathaiva ca .. 45 ..
3.45.d:
सुभीमां देवसेनां च वेलां ज्योत्स्नां तथा शचीम्॥
गौरीं वरुणपत्नीं च यमपत्नीं तथैव च ॥ 45 ॥
3.45.m: Subhīmā, Devasenā, Velā, Jyotsnā, and Śacī, / Gaurī, the wife of Varuṇa, and the wife of Yama,

3.45.s: dhūmorṇāṃ sumahābhāgāṃ mṛtyucchāyāṃ tathaiva ca .. 46 ..
3.45.d: धूमोर्णां सुमहाभागां मृत्युच्छायां तथैव च ॥ 46 ॥
3.45.m: the exceedingly fortunate Dhūmorṇā, and likewise Mṛtyucchāyā,

3.45.s:
abhīṣṭāṃ devajananīṃ devapatnīṃ tathaiva ca ..
pūjayankāmamāpnoti tasyā hyekamasaṃśayam ..
airāvataṃ vā garuḍamuccaiḥśravasameva vā..47..
3.45.d:
अभीष्टां देवजननीं देवपत्नीं तथैव च ॥
पूजयन्काममाप्नोति तस्या ह्येकमसंशयम् ॥
ऐरावतं वा गरुडमुच्चैःश्रवसमेव वा॥47॥
3.45.m: the beloved mother of the gods, and likewise the wife of a god— / worshipping [her], one undoubtedly attains one desire from her. / Or Airāvata, or Garuḍa, or Uccaiḥśravas,

3.45.s:
harasya vṛṣabhaṃ caiva śastrāṇyastrāṇi yāni ca..
tadā sampūjayanrājā vijayaṃ tamupāśnute ..48..
3.45.d:
हरस्य वृषभं चैव शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि यानि च॥
तदा सम्पूजयन्राजा विजयं तमुपाश्नुते ॥48॥
3.45.m: or the bull of Hara, and whatever weapons and missiles there be— / worshipping them at that time, a king attains that victory.

3.45.s:
tathā bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣasya pañcamīm ..
nāgasaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā dhanabhāgī bhavennaraḥ .. 49 ..
3.45.d:
तथा भाद्रपदे मासि शुक्लपक्षस्य पञ्चमीम् ॥
नागसंपूजनं कृत्वा धनभागी भवेन्नरः ॥ 49 ॥
3.45.m: Likewise, having performed the worship of the Nāgas on the fifth [lunar day] of the bright fortnight / in the month of Bhādrapada, a man becomes a possessor of wealth.

3.45.s:
kumāraśca tathā skando viśākhaśca guhastathā ..
caturātmā vinirdiṣṭo bhagavānkrauñcadāraṇaḥ.. 3.221.50 ..
3.45.d:
कुमारश्च तथा स्कन्दो विशाखश्च गुहस्तथा ॥
चतुरात्मा विनिर्दिष्टो भगवान्क्रौञ्चदारणः॥ 3.221.50 ॥
3.45.m: Kumāra, Skanda, Viśākha, and Guha— / the blessed cleaver of Mount Krauñca is declared as fourfold in nature.

3.45.s:
tamabhyarcya naraḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ putrānāpnotyabhīpsitān ..
bālakānāṃ gṛhe śreyo naraḥ prāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 51 ..
3.45.d:
तमभ्यर्च्य नरः षष्ठ्यां पुत्रानाप्नोत्यभीप्सितान् ॥
बालकानां गृहे श्रेयो नरः प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥ 51 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped him on the sixth [lunar day], a man obtains the sons he desires; / a man undoubtedly attains welfare for the children in his house.

3.45.s:
ṛtūnāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tatra kṣemamavāpnuyāt ..
skandapārśvacarānrājanbhīmapārśvacarāṃstathā .. 52 ..
3.45.d:
ऋतूनां पूजनं कृत्वा तत्र क्षेममवाप्नुयात् ॥
स्कन्दपार्श्वचरान्राजन्भीमपार्श्वचरांस्तथा ॥ 52 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped the seasons, one obtains security therein. / [Worshipping] the attendants of Skanda, O king, and the attendants of Bhīma,

3.45.s:
yamapārśvacarām̐ścaiva rogamuktimavāpnuyāt ..
kālapāśau tathābhyarcya jvaravyādhīśameva ca .. 53 ..
3.45.d:
यमपार्श्वचराम्̐श्चैव रोगमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् ॥
कालपाशौ तथाभ्यर्च्य ज्वरव्याधीशमेव च ॥ 53 ॥
3.45.m: and the attendants of Yama, one obtains release from disease. / Having worshipped the two nooses of Kāla, and the lord of fevers and diseases,

3.45.s:
rogamokṣamavāpnoti vāyuvahnīndavastathā ..
caitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ viśeṣeṇa skandamabhyarcayennaraḥ..54..
3.45.d:
रोगमोक्षमवाप्नोति वायुवह्नीन्दवस्तथा ॥
चैत्रषष्ठ्यां विशेषेण स्कन्दमभ्यर्चयेन्नरः॥54॥
3.45.m: one obtains release from disease; likewise Vāyu, Agni, and the Moon. / On the sixth [lunar day] of Caitra, a man should specially worship Skanda;

3.45.s:
pūrvoktaphalamāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ..
saptamyāṃ ca samabhyarcya sūryapatnīṃ suvarcalām ..55..
3.45.d:
पूर्वोक्तफलमाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥
सप्तम्यां च समभ्यर्च्य सूर्यपत्नीं सुवर्चलाम् ॥55॥
3.45.m: he obtains the previously stated fruit and goes to the world of heaven. / And having worshipped Suvarcalā, the wife of Sūrya, on the seventh [lunar day],

3.45.s:
iṣṭānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
devā ekonapañcāśanmaruto nāma kīrtitāḥ .. 56 ..
3.45.d:
इष्टान्कामानवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
देवा एकोनपञ्चाशन्मरुतो नाम कीर्तिताः ॥ 56 ॥
3.45.m: one obtains one's desired wishes—no doubt should be entertained on this point. / The forty-nine gods are celebrated as the Maruts by name;

3.45.s:
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ divamāpnuyāt ..
iṣṭapūjāṃ ca śailasya tadā kṛtvā sukhī bhavet .. 57 ..
3.45.d:
तेषां संपूजनं कृत्वा सप्तम्यां दिवमाप्नुयात् ॥
इष्टपूजां च शैलस्य तदा कृत्वा सुखी भवेत् ॥ 57 ॥
3.45.m: having worshipped them on the seventh [lunar day], one attains heaven. / And having performed the desired worship of a mountain at that time, one becomes happy.

3.45.s:
pūjayitvā tathābhīṣṭāṃ saritaṃ puṇyabhāgbhavet ..
vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 58 ..
3.45.d:
पूजयित्वा तथाभीष्टां सरितं पुण्यभाग्भवेत् ॥
वह्निसंपूजनं कृत्वा वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥ 58 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped a desired river, one becomes a sharer in merit. / Having performed the worship of Agni, one obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

3.45.s:
vāyoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā prāpnoti paramāṅgatim ..
saṃpūjya ca ṛṣīnsapta somasaṃsthāstu ye smṛtāḥ .. 59 ..
3.45.d:
वायोः संपूजनं कृत्वा प्राप्नोति परमाङ्गतिम् ॥
संपूज्य च ऋषीन्सप्त सोमसंस्थास्तु ये स्मृताः ॥ 59 ॥
3.45.m: Having performed the worship of Vāyu, one attains the supreme state. / And having worshipped the seven sages, who are commemorated as abiding in Soma,

3.45.s:
sapta prāpnoti lokānvai gatimagryāṃ ca vindati ..
saptamyāṃ yaduśārdūla iṣṭamabhyarcayanmunim .. 3.221.60 ..
3.45.d:
सप्त प्राप्नोति लोकान्वै गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥
सप्तम्यां यदुशार्दूल इष्टमभ्यर्चयन्मुनिम् ॥ 3.221.60 ॥
3.45.m: one attains the seven worlds and gains the foremost state. / Worshipping one's chosen sage on the seventh [lunar day], O tiger of the Yadus,

3.45.s:
svādhyāyaphalamāpnoti tadvatsāphalyamaśnute ..
pūjayitvā samudrāṃśca drīpānatha tathā naraḥ .. 61 ..
3.45.d:
स्वाध्यायफलमाप्नोति तद्वत्साफल्यमश्नुते ॥
पूजयित्वा समुद्रांश्च द्रीपानथ तथा नरः ॥ 61 ॥
3.45.m: one obtains the fruit of recitation of scripture, and likewise enjoys success. / And having worshipped the oceans and the continents, a man,

3.45.s:
pātālānvā mahābhāga bhuvamāpnotyabhīpsitām ..
saptalokāṃstathā tatra pūjayitvā sukhī bhavet .. 62 ..
3.45.d:
पातालान्वा महाभाग भुवमाप्नोत्यभीप्सिताम् ॥
सप्तलोकांस्तथा तत्र पूजयित्वा सुखी भवेत् ॥ 62 ॥
3.45.m: or the netherworlds, O fortunate one, attains his desired land. / Having worshipped the seven worlds there, one becomes happy,

3.45.s:
teṣveva ca tathaivāgryāṃ gatimapratimāṃ labhet ..
gaṅgāṃ saptaprakārāṃ ca tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm .. 63 ..
3.45.d:
तेष्वेव च तथैवाग्र्यां गतिमप्रतिमां लभेत् ॥
गङ्गां सप्तप्रकारां च तथा देवीं सरस्वतीम् ॥ 63 ॥
3.45.m: and in those very [worlds] one attains the foremost, matchless state. / [Worshipping] the sevenfold Gaṅgā and the goddess Sarasvatī,

3.45.s:
saptayajñānavāpnoti naraḥ saṃpūjayandhruvam ..
ādityaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ śīghraṃ rogairvimucyate .. 64 ..
3.45.d:
सप्तयज्ञानवाप्नोति नरः संपूजयन्ध्रुवम् ॥
आदित्यं पूजयेद्देवं शीघ्रं रोगैर्विमुच्यते ॥ 64 ॥
3.45.m: a man worshipping [them] surely attains the seven sacrifices. / One should worship the god Āditya; one is quickly freed from diseases.

3.45.s:
saptamyāṃ yādavaśreṣṭha gatimagryāṃ ca vindati ..
evaṃ supūjanaṃ kṛtvā gatimagryāṃ tathā labhet .. 65 ..
3.45.d:
सप्तम्यां यादवश्रेष्ठ गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥
एवं सुपूजनं कृत्वा गतिमग्र्यां तथा लभेत् ॥ 65 ॥
3.45.m: On the seventh [lunar day], O best of Yādavas, one gains the foremost state. / Having performed proper worship in this way, one likewise attains the foremost state.

3.45.s:
jayantaṃ śakratanayaṃ pūjayitvā sukhī bhavet ..
aṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā vasūnāṃ dharmasattama .. 66 ..
3.45.d:
जयन्तं शक्रतनयं पूजयित्वा सुखी भवेत् ॥
अष्टम्यां पूजनं कृत्वा वसूनां धर्मसत्तम ॥ 66 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped Jayanta, the son of Śakra, one becomes happy. / Having performed the worship of the Vasus on the eighth [lunar day], O best of the righteous,

3.45.s:
nākalokamavāpnoti gatimagryāṃ ca vindati ..
ekānaṃśāṃ tadā devīṃ tathā saṃpūjayennaraḥ .. 67 ..
3.45.d:
नाकलोकमवाप्नोति गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥
एकानंशां तदा देवीं तथा संपूजयेन्नरः ॥ 67 ॥
3.45.m: he attains the heavenly world and finds the highest path. / If a man then likewise worships the goddess Ekānaṃśā,

3.45.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
mahādevaṃ samabhyarcya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 68 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
महादेवं समभ्यर्च्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 68 ॥
3.45.m: he enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice rich in all desires. / Having worshipped Mahādeva, he would obtain all desires.

3.45.s:
vīrabhadraṃ sanaṃdīśaṃ laguḍeśaṃ tathaiva ca..
bhadrakālīṃ tathābhyarcya navamyāṃ yadunandana .. 69 ..
3.45.d:
वीरभद्रं सनंदीशं लगुडेशं तथैव च॥
भद्रकालीं तथाभ्यर्च्य नवम्यां यदुनन्दन ॥ 69 ॥
3.45.m: Having likewise worshipped Vīrabhadra, together with Nandin and Laguḍeśa, / and Bhadrakālī on the ninth [lunar day], O joy of the Yadus,

3.45.s:
kāmamekamavāpnoti yaṃ kañcinmanasepsitam ..
catuṣpatheṣu ramyeṣu tathaivāṭṭālakeṣu ca .. 3.221.70 ..
3.45.d:
काममेकमवाप्नोति यं कञ्चिन्मनसेप्सितम् ॥
चतुष्पथेषु रम्येषु तथैवाट्टालकेषु च ॥ 3.221.70 ॥
3.45.m: he obtains a single desire, whatever is wished for in his mind. / At charming crossroads, and likewise on watchtowers,

3.45.s:
giriśṛṅgeṣu ramyeṣu nadītīreṣu cāpyatha ..
guhāsu caiva ramyāsu piśācānāṃ baliṃ haret .. 71 ..
3.45.d:
गिरिशृङ्गेषु रम्येषु नदीतीरेषु चाप्यथ ॥
गुहासु चैव रम्यासु पिशाचानां बलिं हरेत् ॥ 71 ॥
3.45.m: on lovely mountain peaks, and on riverbanks, / and in charming caves, one should offer an oblation for the piśācas.

3.45.s:
śakrādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ ye ca pārśvacarāḥ surāḥ ..
teṣāṃ balimupākurvankṣemamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 72 ..
3.45.d:
शक्रादीनां च देवानां ये च पार्श्वचराः सुराः ॥
तेषां बलिमुपाकुर्वन्क्षेममाप्नोति मानवः ॥ 72 ॥
3.45.m: And for the gods who are attendants of deities beginning with Śakra, / offering an oblation to them, a mortal attains security.

3.45.s:
āyudhaṃ pūjayitvā ca tathā vijayamāpnuyāt ..
vidyāmāpnoti vipulāṃ pūjayitvā sarasvatīm .. 73 ..
3.45.d:
आयुधं पूजयित्वा च तथा विजयमाप्नुयात् ॥
विद्यामाप्नोति विपुलां पूजयित्वा सरस्वतीम् ॥ 73 ॥
3.45.m: And having worshipped a weapon, he would likewise attain victory. / Having worshipped Sarasvatī, he attains extensive learning.

3.45.s:
vidyākāmastu kurvīta tadā pustakapūjanam ..
tathaivāśvayuje śukle bhadrakālīṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 74 ..
3.45.d:
विद्याकामस्तु कुर्वीत तदा पुस्तकपूजनम् ॥
तथैवाश्वयुजे शुक्ले भद्रकालीं विशेषतः ॥ 74 ॥
3.45.m: One who desires learning should then perform the worship of books; / likewise, in the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja, especially to Bhadrakālī.

3.45.s:
navamyāṃ pūjayitvā tu sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
daśamyāṃ pūjayanrājanviśvedevāṃstathā daśa .. 75 ..
3.45.d:
नवम्यां पूजयित्वा तु सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
दशम्यां पूजयन्राजन्विश्वेदेवांस्तथा दश ॥ 75 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped [her] on the ninth [lunar day], he would obtain all desires. / Worshipping the ten Viśvedevas on the tenth [lunar day], O king,

3.45.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
tadā saṃpūjayanrājaṃstathaiva ca diśo daśa .. 76 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
तदा संपूजयन्राजंस्तथैव च दिशो दश ॥ 76 ॥
3.45.m: he enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice rich in all desires. / Then worshipping, O king, likewise the ten directions,

3.45.s:
kriyāsāphalyamāpnoti yatra yatrābhijāyate ..
dharmaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ sarvasattvasukhāvaham .. 77 ..
3.45.d:
क्रियासाफल्यमाप्नोति यत्र यत्राभिजायते ॥
धर्मं संपूज्य देवेशं सर्वसत्त्वसुखावहम् ॥ 77 ॥
3.45.m: he attains success in his actions wherever he is born. / Having worshipped Dharma, lord of gods, bringer of happiness to all beings,

3.45.s:
dharme matimavāpnoti dharmasāphalyameva ca..
ekādaśyāṃ tu saṃpūjya rudrānekādaśaiva ca .. 78 ..
3.45.d:
धर्मे मतिमवाप्नोति धर्मसाफल्यमेव च॥
एकादश्यां तु संपूज्य रुद्रानेकादशैव च ॥ 78 ॥
3.45.m: he obtains a mind set on dharma and the success of dharma. / But having worshipped the eleven Rudras on the eleventh [lunar day],

3.45.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute..
tathā sarvagatānrudrāṃstadā sarvatra pūjayet .. 79 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते॥
तथा सर्वगतान्रुद्रांस्तदा सर्वत्र पूजयेत् ॥ 79 ॥
3.45.m: he enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice rich in all desires. / Likewise, he should then worship everywhere the all-pervading Rudras;

3.45.s:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sarvagānaparājitān ..
tathā ca dvādaśādityāndvādaśyāṃ pūjayennaraḥ .. 3.221.80 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति सर्वगानपराजितान् ॥
तथा च द्वादशादित्यान्द्वादश्यां पूजयेन्नरः ॥ 3.221.80 ॥
3.45.m: he obtains all desires from the all-pervading, invincible ones. / And likewise, on the twelfth [lunar day], a man should worship the twelve Ādityas;

3.45.s:
dvādaśāhamavāpnoti gatimagryāṃ ca vindati ..
dvādaśyāṃ devadeveśaṃ pūjayitvā jalādhipam .. 81 ..
3.45.d:
द्वादशाहमवाप्नोति गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥
द्वादश्यां देवदेवेशं पूजयित्वा जलाधिपम् ॥ 81 ॥
3.45.m: he obtains [the fruit of] a twelve-day rite and finds the highest path. / On the twelfth [lunar day], having worshipped the lord of the gods, the ruler of waters,

3.45.s:
pauṇḍarīkamavāpnoti varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim ..
sarvadeveśvaraṃ śakraṃ pūjayitvā tathā naraḥ .. 82 ..
3.45.d:
पौण्डरीकमवाप्नोति वरुणं यादसां पतिम् ॥
सर्वदेवेश्वरं शक्रं पूजयित्वा तथा नरः ॥ 82 ॥
3.45.m: Varuṇa, the lord of aquatic creatures, he obtains [the fruit of] a Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice. / Having likewise worshipped Śakra, the lord of all gods, a man

3.45.s:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ..
viṣṇoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā kāmānāpnotyabhīpsitān.. 83 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥
विष्णोः संपूजनं कृत्वा कामानाप्नोत्यभीप्सितान्॥ 83 ॥
3.45.m: obtains all desires and goes to the heavenly realm. / Having performed the worship of Viṣṇu, he obtains desired wishes;

3.45.s:
iṣṭayajñaphalaṃ prāpya gatimagryāṃ ca vindati ..
trayodaśyāmathābhyarcya kāmadevaṃ samarcayet .. 84 ..
3.45.d:
इष्टयज्ञफलं प्राप्य गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥
त्रयोदश्यामथाभ्यर्च्य कामदेवं समर्चयेत् ॥ 84 ॥
3.45.m: having attained the fruit of a sacrifice performed, he finds the highest path. / And having reverenced Kāmadeva on the thirteenth [lunar day], he should worship him;

3.45.s:
ayatnātsarvamāpnoti phalaṃ saṃvatsaroditam ..
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tu pūjanam .. 85 ..
3.45.d:
अयत्नात्सर्वमाप्नोति फलं संवत्सरोदितम् ॥
यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च चतुर्दश्यां तु पूजनम् ॥ 85 ॥
3.45.m: effortlessly he obtains all the fruit spoken of for a full year. / But having performed the worship of yakṣas and rākṣasas on the fourteenth [lunar day],

3.45.s:
kṛtvā kṣemamavāpnoti kriyāsāphalyameva ca ..
pūjayitvā dhanādhyakṣaṃ tadā vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum .. 86 ..
3.45.d:
कृत्वा क्षेममवाप्नोति क्रियासाफल्यमेव च ॥
पूजयित्वा धनाध्यक्षं तदा वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् ॥ 86 ॥
3.45.m: he attains security and success in his actions. / Having then worshipped the overseer of wealth, Lord Vaiśravaṇa,

3.45.s:
bahuvittamavāpnoti phalaṃ saṃvatsaroditam ..
śaṃkha padmau tathābhyarcya nidhānau yakṣapūjitau .. 87 ..
3.45.d:
बहुवित्तमवाप्नोति फलं संवत्सरोदितम् ॥
शंख पद्मौ तथाभ्यर्च्य निधानौ यक्षपूजितौ ॥ 87 ॥
3.45.m: he obtains abundant wealth and the fruit spoken of for a full year. / Having likewise worshipped the two treasures, Śaṅkha and Padma, revered by yakṣas,

3.45.s:
maṇibhadraṃ tathābhyarcya dhanamāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. .. 88 ..
3.45.d:
मणिभद्रं तथाभ्यर्च्य धनमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
पूजयित्वा महादेवं सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ ॥ 88 ॥
3.45.m: and having worshipped Maṇibhadra, he obtains wealth without doubt. / Having worshipped Mahādeva, he would obtain all desires,

3.45.s:
māghamāsacaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ..
tathā pitṝngaṇānrājankṣīṇe candre ca pūjayet .. 89 ..
3.45.d:
माघमासचतुर्दश्यां कृष्णपक्षे विशेषतः ॥
तथा पितॄन्गणान्राजन्क्षीणे चन्द्रे च पूजयेत् ॥ 89 ॥
3.45.m: especially on the fourteenth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight in the month of Māgha. / Likewise, O king, when the moon is waning, he should worship the host of ancestors;

3.45.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
śraddhāṃ kṛtvā tathā rājansarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 3.221.90 ..
3.45.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
श्रद्धां कृत्वा तथा राजन्सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.221.90 ॥
3.45.m: he enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice rich in all desires. / Having thus performed the ancestral rite with faith, O king, he would obtain all desires.

3.45.s:
pūrṇaminduṃ tathābhyarcya saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt ..
iṣṭagrahamathābhyarcya nakṣatramatha vārcayet .. 91 ..
3.45.d:
पूर्णमिन्दुं तथाभ्यर्च्य सौभाग्यं महदाप्नुयात् ॥
इष्टग्रहमथाभ्यर्च्य नक्षत्रमथ वार्चयेत् ॥ 91 ॥
3.45.m: Having likewise worshipped the full moon, he would obtain great good fortune. / Having worshipped a desired planet, or having worshipped a constellation,

3.45.s:
tasmātkṣemamavāpnoti kāmaṃ ca yadunandana ..
māsanāma sanakṣatra pūrṇimāyogi yaśca vā..92..
3.45.d:
तस्मात्क्षेममवाप्नोति कामं च यदुनन्दन ॥
मासनाम सनक्षत्र पूर्णिमायोगि यश्च वा॥92॥
3.45.m: from that he attains security and desire, O joy of the Yadus. / Or whatever name of a month, constellation, and conjunction with the full moon there may be,

3.45.s:
pūjayitvā tathā rājansaubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt ..
sopavāsastu nakṣatraṃ nakṣatreśamathārcayet .. 93 ..
3.45.d:
पूजयित्वा तथा राजन्सौभाग्यं महदाप्नुयात् ॥
सोपवासस्तु नक्षत्रं नक्षत्रेशमथार्चयेत् ॥ 93 ॥
3.45.m: having worshipped them, O king, he would obtain great good fortune. / Fasting, he should worship the constellation or the lord of the constellation,

3.45.s:
nakṣatraṃ vā mahābhāga tasmātkāmamavāpnuyāt ..
kārtikeyaṃ mahābhāga kṛttikāsvarcayennaraḥ .. 94 ..
3.45.d:
नक्षत्रं वा महाभाग तस्मात्काममवाप्नुयात् ॥
कार्तिकेयं महाभाग कृत्तिकास्वर्चयेन्नरः ॥ 94 ॥
3.45.m: or the constellation, O fortunate one; from that he would obtain his desire. / A man should worship Kārttikeya, O fortunate one, under Kṛttikā;

3.45.s:
vahniṣṭomamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet ..
kṛttikāsu tathābhyarcya khaḍgaṃ vijayamāpnuyāt .. 95 ..
3.45.d:
वह्निष्टोममवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥
कृत्तिकासु तथाभ्यर्च्य खड्गं विजयमाप्नुयात् ॥ 95 ॥
3.45.m: he obtains [the fruit of] an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice and rescues his lineage. / Having likewise worshipped a sword under Kṛttikā, he would attain victory.

3.45.s:
bhaujaṅge nāgamabhyarcya śriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām ..
kāmadevamathābhyarcya bhāgye saubhāgyavānbhavet .. 96 ..
3.45.d:
भौजङ्गे नागमभ्यर्च्य श्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
कामदेवमथाभ्यर्च्य भाग्ये सौभाग्यवान्भवेत् ॥ 96 ॥
3.45.m: Having worshipped the serpent under Āśleṣā, he obtains unsurpassed prosperity. / Having worshipped Kāmadeva under Pūrvaphalgunī, he would become fortunate.

3.45.s:
sāvitraṃ ca tathā haste śriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām ..
iṣṭagrahābhitaddehaṃ tannāmādhyakṣasevayā .. 97 ..
3.45.d:
सावित्रं च तथा हस्ते श्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
इष्टग्रहाभितद्देहं तन्नामाध्यक्षसेवया ॥ 97 ॥
3.45.m: And [having worshipped] Savitṛ under Hasta, he obtains unsurpassed prosperity. / Facing the body of the desired planet through devotion to the presiding deity of that name,

3.45.s:
gandharvaṃ vā grahaṃ vāpi tasmātkāmānavāpnuyāt ..
kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ mahākālamathārcayet .. 98 ..
3.45.d:
गन्धर्वं वा ग्रहं वापि तस्मात्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
कृष्णपक्षचतुर्दश्यां महाकालमथार्चयेत् ॥ 98 ॥
3.45.m: or [worshipping] a gandharva or a planet, he would obtain his desires from that. / On the fourteenth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight, he should worship Mahākāla;

3.45.s:
tasmātkāmamavāpnoti yatheṣṭaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
māheśvaraṃ mātṛgaṇaṃ tathā tatrāgnipūjanam .. 99 ..
3.45.d:
तस्मात्काममवाप्नोति यथेष्टं नात्र संशयः ॥
माहेश्वरं मातृगणं तथा तत्राग्निपूजनम् ॥ 99 ॥
3.45.m: from that he obtains desire as wished; there is no doubt in this. / Worship of the host of Mothers of Maheśvara, and worship of fire there,

3.45.s: ekavāsāntaraṃ rājankāmamāpnotyabhīpsitam .. 3.221.100 ..
3.45.d: एकवासान्तरं राजन्काममाप्नोत्यभीप्सितम् ॥ 3.221.100 ॥
3.45.m: with a single garment, O king, he obtains his cherished desire.

3.45.s:
tathā tumbarusambaddhaṃ pañcakaṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
sarvatra jayamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 101 ..
3.45.d:
तथा तुम्बरुसम्बद्धं पञ्चकं पूजयेन्नरः ॥
सर्वत्र जयमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 101 ॥
3.45.m: Likewise, a man should worship the pentad connected with Tumburu; / he attains victory everywhere; no doubt should be entertained here.

3.45.s:
kṛttikāsu naro'bhyarcya skandapārśvacarām̐stathā ..
ārogyaṃ mahadāpnoti sadā vā manasepsitam..102..
3.45.d:
कृत्तिकासु नरोऽभ्यर्च्य स्कन्दपार्श्वचराम्̐स्तथा ॥
आरोग्यं महदाप्नोति सदा वा मनसेप्सितम्॥102॥
3.45.m: A man worshipping under Kṛttikā the attendants of Skanda / attains great health or constantly what is wished for in his mind.

3.45.s:
nṛsiṃhapratibaddhāṃ tu pūrṇe candre samarcayet..
naro mātṛgaṇaṃ cārcya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt..103..
3.45.d:
नृसिंहप्रतिबद्धां तु पूर्णे चन्द्रे समर्चयेत्॥
नरो मातृगणं चार्च्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्॥103॥
3.45.m: At the full moon, one should worship the [female powers] connected with Nṛsiṃha; / and having worshipped the host of Mothers, a man would obtain all desires.

3.45.s:
ekāṃ vā mātaraṃ rājankāmānāpnotyabhīpsitān ..
vānaspatyamavāpnoti pūjayitvā vanaspatīn .. 104 ..
3.45.d:
एकां वा मातरं राजन्कामानाप्नोत्यभीप्सितान् ॥
वानस्पत्यमवाप्नोति पूजयित्वा वनस्पतीन् ॥ 104 ॥
3.45.m: Or [having worshipped] a single Mother, O king, he obtains desired wishes. / Having worshipped the trees, he attains lordly dominion over trees.

3.45.s:
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ vā tatpakṣā ye tathāpare ..
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāṃ sukhī bhavet .. 105 ..
3.45.d:
दैत्यानां दानवानां वा तत्पक्षा ये तथापरे ॥
तेषां संपूजनं कृत्वा चतुर्दश्यां सुखी भवेत् ॥ 105 ॥
3.45.m: Having performed the worship of Daityas or Dānavas and others belonging to their side / on the fourteenth [lunar day], he would become happy.

3.45.s:
karaṇe vā muhurte vā yathāvaddevamarcayet ..
tasmātkāmamavāpnoti gatimagryāṃ ca vindati .. 106 ..
3.45.d:
करणे वा मुहुर्ते वा यथावद्देवमर्चयेत् ॥
तस्मात्काममवाप्नोति गतिमग्र्यां च विन्दति ॥ 106 ॥
3.45.m: In a karaṇa or in a muhūrta, he should worship the deity properly; / from that he obtains his desire and finds the highest path.

3.45.s:
caitramāsādathārabhya yathoktena naraḥ sadā ..
iṣṭaṃ devamathābhyarcya yathoktaṃ phalamaśnute .. 107 ..
3.45.d:
चैत्रमासादथारभ्य यथोक्तेन नरः सदा ॥
इष्टं देवमथाभ्यर्च्य यथोक्तं फलमश्नुते ॥ 107 ॥
3.45.m: Beginning from the month of Caitra, according to what has been said, / a man who constantly worships his chosen deity enjoys the fruit as spoken of.

3.45.s:
saṃvatsareṇa dharmajña nakṣatre yadi vā tithau ..
grahe vā sarvadharmajña sopavāsassamāhitaḥ .. 108 ..
3.45.d:
संवत्सरेण धर्मज्ञ नक्षत्रे यदि वा तिथौ ॥
ग्रहे वा सर्वधर्मज्ञ सोपवासस्समाहितः ॥ 108 ॥
3.45.m: Over the course of a year, O knower of dharma, whether under a constellation or on a lunar day / or on a planetary day, O knower of all dharma, fasting and concentrated,

3.45.s:
saṃvatsare vāpyayane ṛtau māse ca taddale ..
naktāśī satataṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tatsvāminaḥ sadā ..
tāvatkālaṃ mahābhāga tasmātkāmamavāpnuyāt .. 109 ..
3.45.d:
संवत्सरे वाप्ययने ऋतौ मासे च तद्दले ॥
नक्ताशी सततं पूजां कृत्वा तत्स्वामिनः सदा ॥
तावत्कालं महाभाग तस्मात्काममवाप्नुयात् ॥ 109 ॥
3.45.m: or in a year, or in a solstice, in a season, in a month, or in its half, / eating only at night, constantly performing the worship of its presiding deity, / for that length of time, O fortunate one, he would obtain his desire from that.

3.45.s:

Thus addressed by the lord of wealth, the great sage replied: / "I wish to hear from you, O protector of wealth, the dharma that bears great fruit."
Vaiśravaṇa said:
"O brahmin, the worship of one's own deity at the light, / a dharma bearing great fruit, O twice-born—hear that from me as I speak.
On all the lights, O twice-born, fasting and with senses subdued, / having performed the worship of the deity, one enjoys the fruit as spoken.
Beginning with the bright [half] of Caitra, [undertaking] the unsurpassed vow on the light, / one should observe it on the light as desired for a year, free from sloth.
On the thirty lights, O foremost of twice-born, concentrated for one month, / eating only at night for a year, one should worship the deity of the light
every day, O greatly fortunate one; through that he attains his desire. / Whoever performs the unsurpassed vow of the light in the month of Āṣāḍha,
eating only at night every day and eating at a single time, O twice-born, / should avoid drinking water at any time other than the time of food.

3.45.m:
Beginning from the light of Brahmā up to the light of the Cosmic Person, / when the light of the Cosmic Person is reached, having satisfied the brahmins
and given garments to the twice-born, as well as gold and silver, / he attains the world of heaven for a long time, O best of twice-born.
And attaining human birth, he is born handsome, / ever free from disease, strong, and also victorious over enemies and powerful.
He obtains foremost women, birth in an excellent family, / attains great good fortune, and also supreme charm,
friendship with the virtuous, knowledge, an excellent course in dharma, / foremost vehicles, and whatever else he desires.
The fruitful [vow] for one eating at night on the lights in a month, [worshipping] the best of gods, has been told to you, O twice-born; / hereafter I shall explain to you the distinct fruit for one who properly fasts on a light.

3.45.m:
In the Saura, having worshipped the Sun, he would attain freedom from disease;
in the Candra, having worshipped the Moon, he would obtain supreme bliss.
In the Goroca, having worshipped the cow Surabhi, the mother of the world,
O knower of dharma, he obtains cows and her world as well.
Having reached the lunar day of Niyati, worshipping Niyati,
he attains long life wherever he is born.
In the Vaiṣṇava, having worshipped Viṣṇu, he attains the world of Viṣṇu;
in the Raudra, having worshipped Rudra, he attains his world.
A man obtains sons in the Kaumāra, worshipping Kumāra.
Having performed the worship of the ancestors in the Pitṛroca with concentration,
he obtains his desired worship and goes to the world of the ancestors.
In the Vāruṇa, worshipping the god Varuṇa, he obtains horses.
And in the Ananta, having worshipped Ananta, the supporter of the earth,
he attains the endless fruit of his well-performed deed.
In the Vāyavya, having worshipped Vāyu, he would obtain profit in trade;
in the Yāmya, having worshipped Yama, he meets with no fear from hell.

In the Sārasvata, having worshipped the goddess Sarasvatī, O twice-born one,
he obtains learning according to his wish, and through it becomes an eloquent speaker.
In the Śrīroca, having worshipped Śrī, he obtains radiant fortune.
And in my own roca, a man worshipping me
becomes a possessor of wealth wherever he is born.
In the Śailaroca, having worshipped the mountain, he becomes happy.
In the Bhūroca, having worshipped the Earth, he obtains an unsurpassed realm.
Having performed the worship of the Vedas in the Vedaroca with concentration,
a man obtains the Vedas, and a lord of men obtains sacrifices.
And in the Pauruṣa roca, worshipping the Cosmic Person in water,
he obtains all desires and finds the means to liberation.
Worshipping the ancient Cosmic Person who is devoid of form, devoid of touch, devoid of smell, devoid of taste, / and devoid of sound, he attains the path of liberation.

having heard singing and instrumental music, and having watched charming dance,
having stayed there for one night, honoured by the Guardian of Wealth,
that righteous twice-born one went north towards the snowy mountain.

shining like a mass of moonbeams, endowed with all objects of desire.
In that house he then saw an old, beautiful woman,
adorned with all ornaments, surrounded by many

and with pleasant-to-the-touch breezes and various fragrances,
she smeared his limbs with fragrant sandalwood paste;

3.45.m:
She fed him with food abundant in all desirable things,
and gave him fragrant, very charming betel.
In that wonderful house, she provided a very charming bed
with a white counterpane, variegated, well-spread, and exceedingly luxurious.
Having dismissed all those fawn-eyed women,
that passionate lady went to sleep there in another such [bed].
Then, late at night, under the pretext of cold, from her own bed
that fair-complexioned lady went to the bed of Aṣṭāvakra.
Seeing her arrived at his bed, he said, 'What is this?
O lady of sweet smiles, this is not appropriate for your age.
My celibacy is unbroken, and I avoid the wives of others.
Disregarding me so freely, what do you wish to do?'
The Direction said:
'O twice-born one, it is not only in youth that we women are fickle;
even at the end of life, impelled by desire, we indulge in fickleness.

3.45.m:
I think you have not heard the nature of women, O best of the twice-born!
They are not attracted by age, nor by beauty, nor by lineage, nor by sacred learning.
Only rarely are they attracted by character, dress, wealth, or valour;
they desire any man as he comes to hand—such is the sacred tradition.'
For those women over whom great guard is kept, attach themselves to hunches and dwarfs,
or even to servants here, O descendant of Bhṛgu, [if they are] a man.
Fire is not sated with firewood, nor the great ocean with rivers,
nor Death with all beings, nor the fair-eyed women with men.
Smiling women destroy a family in mere sport;
for [faithfulness] to a woman’s lover by nature is hard to find, O foremost of the Bhṛgus.
There is no secrecy, there is no opportunity, and there is no wooer;
by that, O knower of dharma, the chastity of women is maintained.
You were sent to me, O fortunate one, by that great-souled [sage],
to understand here the character of women as seen and heard by us.

3.45.m:
Knowing this, however, you must not feel revulsion toward women;
for women are the very root of dharma, wealth, and pleasure.
Fire, food, and water are the causes of men’s sustenance,
and the very same are declared to be destroyers; so too women should be understood.
Just as there is no livelihood in the world without fire, food, and water,
so the householder stage of life cannot exist in any way without women.
Therefore they are to be guarded with wisdom, not harshly and not softly;
women are the root of misfortunes, and [yet] the means to the three aims of life.
One should not place trust in them, but should guard them like a jewel;
making them busy with household duties, they must be guarded by one who desires prosperity.
Having heard this, honored by that woman on the second day,
he went to the abode of Kubera, and from there to his [prospective] father-in-law's house.
Then, having approached his father-in-law, he reported everything to him;
and having heard about the conduct of women, he asked that brahmin:

Having obtained that dark-eyed wife, the root of the three aims of life,

and having bathed with the Puruṣasūkta, with a restrained mind,
having performed libation with it, and recitation, O best of men,
a man should worship Janārdana as the Haṃsa in the center of an eight-petaled lotus,
honored with the Puruṣasūkta,
copiously with flowers, and likewise with incense, and thereafter with fruits,
and then with a lamp, O king, and after that with food offering.
Then one should worship the fire with the Puruṣasūkta;
and then, at the conclusion of the ritual, a milch cow should be given.
Having performed this supreme purifying observance for a year,
one obtains all desires, both celestial and human.
He attains the [merit of the] horse-sacrifice and obtains [that of the] Rājasūya;
having enjoyed pleasures, he subsequently attains liberation without doubt.
This is auspicious, supremely pure, increasing fortune and expanding dharma;
the supreme observance known as Haṃsavrata should be performed by a man in the world of men.

3.227

एतं मे संशयं छिन्धि भृगुवंशविवर्धन ॥1॥

ऋषय ऊचुः ॥

हंस उवाच॥

3.46.m:
Having acted thus in the form of a swan, the lost knowledge was imparted by Viṣṇu to the foremost brahmins. / When knowledge was gained on the earth, all the foremost brahmins were freed from sorrow, O hero among men!
3.227
Vajra said:
What was spoken by that Swan to the self-composed sages? / Cut away this doubt of mine, O enhancer of the Bhṛgu lineage!
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Much was spoken by that Swan to the self-composed sages. / Therefore, I shall speak some of it; listen to it from me as I recite:
The sages said:
Declare the dharma of the castes and stages of life, O foremost of the twice-born, / as well as what may and may not be eaten, and likewise purity and ritual impurity.
The Swan said:
Sacrificing, officiating at sacrifices, giving gifts, and acceptance of gifts from the distinguished, / teaching, and study are proclaimed as the duties of a brahmin.
Giving gifts, study, sacrifice, cattle rearing, commerce, / and freedom from malice, O knower of dharma, are considered the common dharma.

आनुलोम्येन वर्णानां जातिर्मातृसमा भवेत् ॥
प्रतिलोमोद्भवाः सर्वे भवन्त्यार्यविगर्हिताः॥6॥
सूतो वैदेहकश्चैव चाण्डालश्च द्विजोत्तमाः॥
विज्ञेया ब्राह्मणीपुत्राः क्षत्रविट्शूद्रयोनितः ॥ 7 ॥
मागधः पुक्कसश्चैव विट्शूद्रैः क्षत्त्रियासुतौ ॥
आयोगवश्च वैश्यायां शूद्रपुत्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 8 ॥
अन्ये वक्तुं न शक्यन्ते सङ्करात्सङ्करोद्भवाः ॥
विवाहः सदृशश्चैषां नोत्तमैर्नाधमैः सह ॥ 9 ॥
सूतानामश्वसारथ्यं मागधानां स्तुतिक्रिया ॥
वैदेहः स्यात्तन्त्रिजीवः पुक्कसानां च व्याधता ॥ 3.227.10 ॥
आयोगवस्य शिल्पानि रंगावतरणं तथा ॥
चण्डालानामसंस्पर्शस्तथा वैधव्यगामिता ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
गोब्राह्मणार्थे समरे हतानां स्त्रीबालहेतोर्यदि वाप्यशेषम् ॥
स्वाम्यर्थकार्यं यदि वा प्रकुर्वतां सिद्धिः प्रदिष्टा न हि संशयोऽत्र ॥ 12 ॥
3.46.m:
In direct order of the castes, the birth is equal to the mother. / All those born in reverse order become despised by the noble.
The Sūta, the Vaidehaka, and the Cāṇḍāla, O foremost twice-born, / are to be known as sons of a brahmin woman from kṣatriya, vaiśya, and śūdra wombs [respectively].
The Māgadha and the Pukkasa are the sons of a kṣatriya woman by vaiśyas and śūdras; / and the Āyogava is proclaimed as the son of a śūdra upon a vaiśya woman.
Others born from intermixture upon intermixture cannot be enumerated. / Their marriage is with equals, not with the higher nor with the lower.
For Sūtas, horsemanship and charioteering; for Māgadhas, the act of praise; / the Vaideha shall subsist by stringed instruments; and for Pukkasas, the profession of a hunter;
for an Āyogava, handicrafts and appearing on stage; / for Caṇḍālas, untouchability and living on execution.
For those slain in battle for the sake of cows and brahmins, or entirely on account of women and children, / or while performing work for the sake of their master, success is ordained; there is no doubt in this.

3.228
The Swan said:
Having initiated the student, the teacher should instruct him in purity first of all, / in conduct, the fire ritual, and the twilight worship.
Rising early in the morning, purified, bathed, having made offerings to the sacred fire, / he should approach the teacher with restraint and perform salutation.
Permitted by the teacher, he should then undertake study. / Then he should perform the round of alms among brahmins according to rule.
He should not beg in the house of the teacher; he may eat with his permission. / He should engage in what is beneficial and dear to the teacher, with devotion, free from egotism.
He should avoid honey, meat, collyrium, ancestral rites, dancing, singing, rashness, / injury, speaking ill of others, and adornment.
He should always, with self-restraint, wear a girdle, an animal skin, and a staff. / Having cast them into the waters when ruined, he should wear others.
The wise student should always sleep on the ground, remain celibate and composed; / having taken such a vow, he should undertake the acquisition of the Veda.

नान्यो धर्मो विद्यते तस्य विप्राश्चैतद्धर्मं तस्य श्रेष्ठं प्रदिष्टम् ॥5॥
3.46.m:
Thus ends the two hundred twenty-eighth chapter, named “The Description of the Vow of the Celibate Student” in the Haṃsagītā, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the third book of the auspicious Viṣṇudharmottara.
3.229
The Swan said:
Then, living in the householder stage of life, having established the fires, knowing dharma, / having married according to rule, and having acquired wealth through dharma,
he should pursue the threefold aims of life there, and sacrifice with various sacrifices; / he should observe proper conduct, and also study the Veda.
He should perform the suspension of the Vedic verses at the end of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa; / the commencement rite is prescribed on the Rohiṇī day of the month of Pauṣa.
After the suspension, he should never study the Veda [anew]; / even then, the study of the scriptures is prescribed for the twice-born.
Effort must be made in the worship of guests; this must be done by householders at all times. / No other dharma exists for him, O brahmins; this is proclaimed as his highest dharma.

3.46.m: A wise man should never eat meat for mere pleasure, O best of the twice-born, as it is a cause of hell. / For he who does not eat meat goes to heaven, and in this world he attains association with happiness. // Thus ends the two hundred and thirtieth chapter, entitled “Avoidance of Edible and Inedible Food” in the Haṃsagītā, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the third book of the illustrious Viṣṇudharmottara.
